known_limitations: The Desktop Commander tool-history source retains a rolling set of recent calls; earlier or later calls may not be available.
Output bodies over the source system limit were replaced with omission markers prior to archival; they cannot be recovered verbatim from this source.
This is a time-window record, not proof of a causally complete capture of all separate ChatGPT workers, all GitHub connector tool calls, or full browser DOM history.
record_scope: Every available Desktop Commander tool event in the defined time window, including possibly unrelated concurrent operations; arguments and retained outputs are unmodified strings.
